# Analysis — #42
type: feature
size: small
risk: low
split: none
prerequisite: none

## Acceptance criteria
- AC #1: Review question types can be chosen in Settings.
- AC #2: The choice is kept after a restart.

## Requirement map
| issue requirement | AC |
|---|---|
| Review question types can be chosen in Settings | AC #1 |
| The choice is kept after a restart | AC #2 |

## Assumptions
- The existing review-type preference key is reused.

input.note: The tech-lead stopped at design (missing-input): "which screens get it?". docs/specs/42/analysis.md only says "Review question types can be chosen in Settings" (AC #1) and "The choice is kept after a restart" (AC #2). It does not name the screen or screens that show the setting, and nothing in the analysis settles it. Re-running analyze would only repeat this unless the Issue text names the screens, and I could not read issue.md from this call. A human needs to say which Settings screen(s) get the review question-type choice.

recommendation.note: Ask the human which Settings screen(s) get the review question-type choice (AC #1). If the Issue text names them, add them to analysis.md AC #1 and the requirement map, then continue from design. If it does not, the human must decide.
